name: Kaçkar Mountains National Park
story: Kaçkar Mountains National Park rises above the Black Sea coast in northeastern Turkey. Declared a national park in 1994, it features glaciated, alpine mountains with steep rocky peaks and mountain lakes. Wolves, bears, boars, feral goats, deer, jackals, and wild chickens live here.
matters: The park provides a breeding habitat for the Caucasian grouse, a bird that breeds in the Caucasus and Pontic Mountains of northeast Turkey. It is a Near Threatened species with a declining population.
